profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer who is passionate about delivering high quality, usable, maintainable software. Current I work in the Online Media field and am skilled in the following technologies.

Languages:
- Proficient: Golang, Java, Ruby, Python
- Familar: Javascript, Nodejs, C#, C/++

Technologies:
- HTML Media Source Extensions and Encrypted Media Extensions specifications
- DRM: Widevine, Playready, Marlin, Adobe Access
- Video Delivery Formats: HLS V3/4/5, MPEG-DASH, HDS, Smooth Streaming
- Cloud computing: extensive experience using AWS and familiar with GCP
- Continuous Delivery: Chef, Docker, CoreOS
- CDNs: Akamai, Fastly, Cloudfront
- Testing Frameworks: Junit, Cucumber, Rspec

positions.title: Infrastructure Software Engineer - Edge Traffic
positions.description:
Designed and shipped a DDoS protection engine that mitigated a 2 million request-per-second DDoS attack.

Partnered with the Checkout team to architect a domain name and TLS certificate management system that lead to tens of millions of dollars in new revenue.

Maintained and extended Stripe’s internet-facing infrastructure: Nginx reverse-proxies, Go services, TLS certificate security, Route53 DNS records, and EC2 infrastructure.

Introduced and facilitated bi-weekly sprint retrospectives to the team where we identified improvements to development and operational processes.

Go-to reviewer for large and/or complex changes by junior and senior team members.

Designed and prototyped a system for automating TLS certificate renewal to reduce operational load from 20 hours per quarter to 15 minutes per week.

Mentored an intern to the successful completion of their project for which they received a return job offer.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Cost Platform
positions.description:
Eliminated billing SLA incidents by optimizing dozens of Scala Spark jobs  handling 10s of TBs of data to reduce landing time of daily billing Airflow pipeline from over 30 hours to under 20 hours.

Lead 3-person team to build a UI for modeling credit card transaction fees, reducing the quarterly model update process from a two-week scramble involving 4 software developers  to a less-than-one-week process for three operators and no developers.

Responsible for team’s contribution to a cross-organisation project to support a new feature for Stripe’s largest customer; gradually extended and refactored over 30 Scala Spark programs in Stripe’s billing pipeline consisting of tens of thousands of lines of code, error-free.

Bootstrapped team charter metrics for tracking billing accuracy and timeliness allowing us to identify and fix errors before they reached users

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Lead launch of new video ingestion and encoding pipeline, reducing transcoding costs by over 50%.
•	Spearheaded experiment to collect objective data on video quality using VMAF
•	Maintained fault-tolerant microservices for Content Management System
•	Planned implementation of shared-storage models across media processing workers using AWS Elastic Filesystem
•	Successfully executed adoption of running behavioural tests using Cucumber in application CI for new microservices
•	Standardized the use of the go-kit toolkit for new Go microservices across teams in the Software Services department
•	Leveraged AWS to build media ingestion and streaming platform
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon SQS · Systems Design · Technical Planning · Cloud Computing · Distributed Systems · Representational State Transfer (REST) · Message Queue · Technical Leadership · Data Streaming · Terraform · Computer Science · Enterprise Software · Video Processing · Agile Application Development · Software as a Service (SaaS) · Microservices · Technical Architecture · Linux · Behavior-Driven Development (BDD)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on Brightcove Bolt, a next generation media streaming platform from its beginning as a JIT (Just-In-Time) packaged media delivery proof of concept to a fully-formed product offering.

Designed and Implemented:
- Go services for dynamic generation of media streaming manfests. Formats included: DASH, HLS V3-5, and Smooth Streaming 
- Go service for JIT repackaging and encrypting of media at the origin. Media formats included: DASH, HLS V4-5, and Smooth Streaming. Encryption formats included: Widevine, Playready and encrypted HLS
- Management API for managing metadata required to support JIT creation of manifests and media for customers' content
- Solution for 0-downtime deployment of configuration changes to NGINX running in a docker container
- CDN configurations for caching of JIT packaged media. CDNs included: Akamai, Cloudfront, and Fastly

Practiced TDD (Test Driven Development) for all code changes

Leveraged Cucumber for BDD (Behaviour Driven Development) of all new features

Responsible for designing Jmeter profiling tests to determine AWS resource requirements of all microservices in media playback chain

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked on the DRM team, designing and implementing solutions for the packaging of video content using multiple DRM schemes such as Playready, Widevine, Flash Access and Marlin.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: I developed an efficient method for quickly diagnosing whether a medical device was operating correctly, or was defective.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · Agile Application Development · Linux

organizations.name: McGill Outdoors Club
organizations.description:
As an executive on the McGill I was responsible for organizing and leading trips for groups of students of all levels of experience. The trips varied in size between 4 and 60 participants.
Excursions included:
- Canoe camping
- Bicycle touring
- Backcountry skiing
- Whitewater kayaking

From September 2011-April 2012 I was responsible with coordinating the maintenance and establishment of a network trails with the CRPF, a non-profit conservation society just north of Montreal.
